cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whether I broke the window isn't on this repair agenda. I taught you to chair one subject at a time; read the heading before asking me that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's have a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A much clearer heading than you used to write. After the repairs; we need somewhere safe to hold it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the venue change through planning first. You always moved the chairs before we agreed where they went. We'll discuss your new location before opening responsibility.

reason: Replace generic teaching tags with exact trained habits and corrections that shape the Drive pursuit. Keep B concerns concrete and each A response tied to new B information.
